label: Location
cap: The approximate city and region your internet connection appears to be in, looked up from your IP address by our own server.

label: Device Type
cap: Whether you are on a desktop, mobile or tablet, and which operating system, as your browser announces it.

label: Browser
cap: Which browser and which major version you are using.

label: Internet Provider
cap: The name of the company that provides your internet connection, looked up from your IP address by our own server.

label: Time Pattern
cap: The local day and time on your device at the moment the scan ran.

label: Screen Resolution
cap: The width and height of your screen in pixels.

label: Privacy Settings
cap: Whether your browser is set to send the Do Not Track request.

label: Connection Type
cap: The kind of connection your browser says it is on (fast mobile, Wi-Fi and so on).

label: How You Found Us
cap: Which kind of site sent you here (search engine, social network, a link, or directly).

label: Device Status
cap: Your battery percentage and whether it is charging, where the browser allows it.

label: Primary Language
cap: The main language your browser is set to.

label: Language Fallbacks
cap: The extra languages your browser lists after the main one.

label: Locale Mismatch
cap: Whether your language setting looks out of step with the timezone you are in.

label: Estimated Profile
cap: A rough age-band guess that the site makes from your operating system, browser and the time of day.

label: User Profile
cap: A one-word lifestyle label (local, traveler, expatriate, multilingual) worked out from your language settings.

label: Orientation
cap: Whether your screen is held upright or sideways.

label: Rotation
cap: The angle your screen is rotated to, in degrees.

label: Tilt Forward/Back
cap: How far your device is tilted forward or back, if it has a motion sensor and has permission.

label: Tilt Left/Right
cap: How far your device is tilted left or right, if it has a motion sensor and has permission.

label: Motion Sensors
cap: Whether your device has a motion sensor (gyroscope) a site could read.

label: Canvas Fingerprint
cap: A short code produced by asking your browser to draw a hidden image; different devices draw it slightly differently.

label: WebGL Signature
cap: The graphics card and driver name your browser reports.

label: Audio Signature
cap: A short code produced by processing a silent sound in your browser; devices differ slightly.

label: Installed Fonts
cap: How many fonts from a test list are installed on your device.

label: Extensions
cap: Whether an ad blocker or browser plug-ins could be detected.

label: Fingerprint Protection
cap: Whether your browser has a known fingerprint shield (Tor, Brave Shields, Firefox protection or a blocking extension).

label: WebRTC Leak
cap: Whether your browser reveals your real internet address to a website even when you use a VPN.

label: CPU Cores
cap: How many processor cores, and how much memory where reported, your device says it has.

label: Display Profile
cap: Your screen size, colour depth and pixel density together.

label: Timezone/Locale
cap: Your timezone and the regional format your browser uses for dates and numbers.

label: Battery Status
cap: The battery level and charging state, or a note that the browser hides it.

label: Connected Devices
cap: How many cameras, microphones and speakers your browser can see, without turning them on.

label: Cookies
cap: How many cookies myprivacytool.io has stored in your browser, and how many look like trackers.

label: Local Storage
cap: How many items this site has saved in your browser's local storage, and how big.

label: Session Storage
cap: How many items this site holds in session storage for this tab, and how big.

label: IndexedDB
cap: How many databases this site has created in your browser.

label: Cache & SW
cap: Whether this site has a background service worker or saved offline files in your browser.

label: Google Account
cap: Whether Google sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

label: Meta Services
cap: Whether Facebook or Instagram sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

label: Microsoft Account
cap: Whether Microsoft sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

label: Social Platforms
cap: Whether sign-in cookies for LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit and other social platforms are visible to this page.

label: Cross-Site Identity
cap: Whether tracking cookies from ad networks and single sign-on are visible to this page.

label: DNS Leak
cap: A test labelled 'DNS leak' that is really a second WebRTC probe for your network addresses.

label: Connection Security
cap: Whether you reached this site over an encrypted connection.

label: Mixed Content
cap: Whether this page loaded any resources over an unencrypted connection.

label: Security Headers
cap: A score for how many protective web headers this site appears to send.

label: Browser Status
cap: Whether your browser version is older than a cut-off the code keeps in a list.

label: Encryption
cap: Which version of encryption your connection is likely using.

label: Mouse Tracking
cap: How many mouse movements the site recorded while you used this page.

label: Keystroke Dynamics
cap: How many keystrokes were timed (not what you typed) while you were on this page.

label: Click Patterns
cap: How many clicks the site recorded and how fast you click.

label: Scroll Behavior
cap: How far down the page you scrolled and how you scrolled.

label: Session Duration
cap: How long you have been on this page, how long active, idle, and how many times you switched tabs.

label: Engagement Map
